column1: # TITLE: Expression data from KEAP1 overexpression and NRF2 siRNA knockdown of A549 NSCLC cell

# SUMMARY: KEAP1 overexpressed and NRF2 siRNA knockdown A549 NSCLC cells were used to identify downstream genes of NRF2 pathway separately and by combinatorial analysis. We used triplicate microarrays of transfected A549 cells with mKeap1-GFP for overexpression
column2: siRNAs targeting NRF2 for knockdown and siGFP as control respectively. As a result
column3: we identified several genes which are involved in cancer metabolic functions in these cells. We used microarrays to identify the gene downregulated in both KEAP1 overexpressed and NRF2 siRNA knockdown A549 NSCLC cells and found a subset of downregulated genes which are involved in metabolic functions.
